_source: Claude error texts as published, not yet captured from a factory run. Claude Code: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/errors (session, weekly and model-family limits, the warning, the server throttle). Anthropic API: the credit-balance and spend-limit error bodies. Add captured texts beside these as real runs produce them.
sessionLimit: You've hit your session limit · resets 3:45pm
weeklyLimit: You've hit your weekly limit · resets Mon 12:00am

unrelated: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '/tmp/agent-io/ticket.md'
